title: [CON-21] Sender identity fields and non-URN types inside MLS bodies contradict §5.2.2 / §13.1 / §14
description: Review finding CON-21: Sender identity fields and non-URN types inside MLS bodies contradict §5.2.2 / §13.1 / §14.3.2 (lens CON). Location: spec/06-calls.md:27; spec/09-interop.md:189; spec/07-compliance.md:221, :227; spec/04-access-control.md:145. Fix: Remove `sender`/`addedBy`/`issuedBy`, or state that each MUST equal the MLS sender and is otherwise ignored. Name `urn:agora:type:ComplianceDisclosureNotice` and `urn:agora:type:DMGroupDescriptor` and add them to the §5.2.3 table. Full text: notes/review/CON-verified.md and notes/review/CON.md.
